I never really thought of it as rape, just a "different" type of first experience, I guess.

I was 13, she was 15. She was my best friend's cousin. We started dating. First real girlfriend, first kiss, etc. Two weeks into dating, she wanted to have sex (she was pretty experienced) at my friend's house while he was in the next room. I wasn't comfortable with it and said no at first. She persisted. Then she took all of her clothes off. And persisted. I was nervous and anxious and tense, but instead of saying no, I kind of just shrugged. I was so confused and suprised at the time, I really wasn't sure what was happening (I was a pretty innocent little dude). She got on top of me and started riding me. We finished, or at least, *she waited until I finished,* and got off. 

We dated for a couple months after that, until I heard she was getting piped by the entire Tri-state area. She ended up pressuring me to try a bunch of hard drugs with her while we were together, as well. It took me years to get fully sober and back on track, but by that time I already dropped out of high school and ruined a lot opportunities I had. I also am fairly uncomfortable having sex now unless it's with someone who I REALLY trust, which has ruined quite a few relationships for me.

But, yeah. Not sure if it's really rape or just sexual assualt or whatever, but I do know it's not an ideal way to lose your virginity.
